text: En Moss & Lantern, en el puzle de los espejos del sótano, si giras la lente mientras el farero sigue caminando se queda pegado y no responde nada, ni siquiera el menú de pausa. Tuve que cerrarlo desde el administrador de tareas y el autoguardado me deja justo en ese punto otra vez. Estoy atascado, no puedo avanzar.
wow, another 'cozy' puzzle game where you walk slowly and read notes. so innovative.

Three problems. One: runs are way too long for how little changes, 45 minutes and the last 20 are the same three enemy types. Two: merchant prices scale so fast that by storm 5 you can't afford anything. Three: meta-progression is so slow it feels like a mobile timer. I put 14 hours in hoping it would open up after unlocking the second ship, and it really doesn't - the new hull just changes your stats a little. The crab crew is adorable and the storm visuals are great, I'll give it that. But a roguelite lives or dies on whether you want to start another run, and after the fifth one I just didn't. Nice art, but the loop doesn't hold up.
